scope: SDCN local calibration and AMGC CPU smoke; expansion is conditional
environment: workspace venv with read-only inheritance of existing CPU scientific packages; additional AMGC dependencies installed only in venv
evaluation: final epoch, labels for diagnostic evaluation only, global Hungarian mapping, raw predictions preserved
expansion_gate: finite training and reproducible protocol, no persistent severe collapse in usable baselines, interpretable late training; AMGC smoke alone does not establish full convergence
next_if_gate_fails: report the failed condition and address implementation/optimization before 5 masks x 3 seeds
development_warning: calibration uses Cora labels for diagnostic comparisons; any configuration choice is exploratory and requires fresh evaluation masks
